build_tracks_by_depth: build tracks from depth maps by projecting world points and filtering with epipolar and depth consistency checks
sample_positive_tracks: sample positive tracks from valid point sets sorted by frame coverage and randomly selected
track_epipolar_check: compute Sampson epipolar distances between consecutive frames for track validation
get_essential_matrix: compute the essential matrix from two sets of extrinsic camera matrices
visualize_tracks_on_images: visualize multi-frame tracks on images with position-based colors and save concatenated frames
